verdict: Meta ads went dark September 15; campaigns are being reactivated now.
narrative: Your Meta campaigns stopped delivering on September 15 and have not spent or produced a lead in 9 days, making the back half of this 28-day window inactive. Over the full period you received 49 leads at $9.87 per lead, but that number belongs entirely to the first half — the current run rate is zero. Organic visibility has also pulled back in the same window, with Google Business Profile activity down and Instagram reach nearly gone. Campaigns are being reactivated this week, and the priority is confirming clean delivery before spend resumes. Expect lead volume to recover over the first week of the next reporting period once ads are confirmed live.
